prompt: Photorealistic isometric product rendering of a footbridge midspan with under-deck vertical tuned mass damper, viewed in a low three-quarter isometric from side and below so both walkway top with pedestrians and underside mechanism are visible. Long steel footbridge deck spanning between two concrete piers over grass, two longitudinal steel girders under deck. At midspan, two transverse galvanized bearer beams clamped across under girders with rows of dark high-strength bolts. Hung below bearers in a V-arrangement: two inner tall coiled helical steel springs and two outer inclined stainless viscous dashpot cylinders with rod ends, all pinned to a central rectangular dark steel block mass about the size of a large travel trunk, roughly half the depth of the main girders. Removable sheet-steel cover panel shown lowered on four short hanger rods well below the mass so mass, springs and dashpots remain fully visible, not enclosed. Operating moment: daytime dense crowd walking on deck above, deck fixed, central mass shown suspended in vertical motion out of phase to calm vibration. Real outdoor daylight with soft product lighting, real materials - weathered painted steel, galvanized beams, oiled coil springs, machined dashpots. Fixed vs moving clearly: deck, bearers and bolts fixed; steel mass and spring coils moving vertically. Clean legible callouts with thin leader lines on small light tags in empty space for Bridge Deck, Transverse Bearers, Tuned Steel Mass, Helical Springs, Viscous Dashpots, Clamp Bolts, Removable Cover, no other text, numbers, logos or markings.
must_not: abstract color blocks and symbolic circles
closed cover that hides mass springs and dashpots
welded joints or altered deck surface
additional text blocks, grids, margins or scale bars
changes_from_previous: First version - no previous rendering, new isometric under-deck view created from sketches.

visual_plan.view: isometric three-quarter from side-below, low enough to see underside mechanism and deck top with crowd, midspan centered
visual_plan.spatial_layout: deck horizontal across top between piers; girders running lengthwise below deck; two transverse bearers crosswise at center midspan; four inclined struts down in V to single centered block mass; cover plate floating below mass on rods; pedestrians on deck top for scale, mass about waist-high relative to person standing below
visual_plan.operating_moment: dense crowd walking at resonance on deck top while under-deck steel mass oscillates vertically on springs with dashpots stroking, cover lowered to reveal motion
visual_plan.transfer_path: pedestrians -> deck vibration -> clamped bearer frame -> springs and dashpots -> oscillating tuned mass where energy is absorbed, deck acceleration reduced to comfortable feel
visual_plan.interactions: bearer beams clamp-locked to longitudinal girders with preloaded bolts; springs seated on bearers and carrying mass from above; dashpots pinned between bearers and mass lugs; mass hangs free to slide vertically; cover hangs on rods below mass detached for view

focus_parts.purpose: carries crowd load and vibrates in first vertical mode
clamps to girders to carry damper without welding
moves vertically to absorb deck resonance
supports mass weight and provides tuned stiffness
conceals unit and lowers for inspection and retuning
